item.title: Manic Kat Records launches UK office in partnership with BSB TV
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: (NYACK, NY – JANUARY 20TH, 2026) New York based indie-punk label Manic Kat Records has opened their first international office, partnering with BSB TV to launch Manic Kat Records UK. A label that has long looked to champion emerging punk and alternative music from beyond the US alone, Manic Kat Records’ international outlook is nothing new.
